item.text: I’ll use the built-in image generation tool with the provided contact sheet as the reference, then place the PNG and receipt at the exact requested paths. I’ll inspect the reference first so the generation prompt can anchor Embry’s identity.

The reference shows Embry with tied-back brown hair, warm light-tan skin, expressive brown eyes, a softly rounded jaw, and a navy top. I’m generating a single 16:9 frame with her face large and readable, keeping the grandmother on the phone secondary.

The generated frame is available under the Codex generated images directory. I’m copying that PNG to the requested frame path, then computing dimensions and SHA-256 directly from the PNG bytes for the receipt.

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'mkdir -p /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260723T212222Z/frames
src=/home/graham/.codex/generated_images/019f90e7-8032-7f82-9673-3316d95819e3/call_lLaY8vaKPy50wfdIVJaseFMV.png
dst=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260723T212222Z/frames/sb_001.attempt_05.png
receipt=/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/cycle_20260723T212222Z/frames/sb_001.attempt_05_scillm_image_generation_receipt.json
cp "$src" "$dst"
sha=$(sha256sum "$dst" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
dims="'$(identify -format '"'%w %h' \""'$dst")
width=${dims% *}
height=${dims#* }
printf '"'{\\n  \"ok\": true,\\n  \"auth\": \"codex_oauth_image_gen\",\\n  \"path\": \"%s\",\\n  \"width\": %s,\\n  \"height\": %s,\\n  \"sha256\": \"%s\"\\n}\\n' \""'$dst" "$width" "$height" "$sha" > "$receipt"
ls -l "$dst" "$receipt"
cat "$receipt"'
